title: Conditions of Redemption — SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program
content:
# Branch Counter Guidance: When a SafeStep Redemption Is Taken

## 1. Program status

Redemptions are taken only on a program whose status is active, or, on a tier whose credit hold redemption rule is honor issued vouchers, on a suspended program for vouchers issued before the suspension.

The program status is read from the company's own SafeStep program record for that program, as it stands before the redemption.

| Program status | Tier's credit hold rule | Voucher issued before the suspension? | Redemption taken? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active | Either rule | Not relevant | Yes |
| Suspended | Honor issued vouchers | Yes | Yes |
| Suspended | Honor issued vouchers | No | No |
| Suspended | Suspend all | Either | No |
| Enrolled or closed | Either rule | Not relevant | No |

## 2. What may be redeemed

A participant on the roster may redeem only product types the tier's allowance covers, from the tier's footwear assortment. Footwear must meet the tier's footwear standard with the rating the job-class table gives for the participant's job class, and eyewear must meet the tier's eyewear standard with permanent side shields where the tier requires side shields and use a prescription no older than the tier's largest prescription age in months with lens options among those the tier covers.

| Item | Must satisfy |
|---|---|
| Any item | A product type the tier covers; the participant is on the roster |
| Footwear | The tier's footwear assortment; the footwear standard; the protection rating for the participant's job class |
| Eyewear | The eyewear standard; permanent side shields where required; a prescription no older than the largest prescription age; covered lens options only |

## 3. Pair limits

A participant redeems at most the tier's footwear pairs per allowance year of footwear and its eyewear pairs per allowance year of eyewear in an allowance year. Pairs are counted per participant, product type and allowance year as the participant's redemptions of that product type in that year, less those redemptions that have been returned.

Example (hypothetical): on a tier allowing one pair of footwear a year, a participant who redeemed one pair and returned it has a count of 0 and may redeem a pair; a participant who redeemed one pair and kept it has a count of 1 and may not redeem another that year.

## 4. Vouchers and approval

A voucher is valid for the tier's voucher validity period in days from issue. A purchase with retail above the tier's approval limit needs the approval of the customer's program administrator.
